text: SAP SE's largest identified family shareholder is Dietmar Hopp Stiftung gGmbH, linked to SAP co-founder Dietmar Hopp's family, which held 5.06% of voting rights as of 15 August 2025 per a German WpHG voting-rights disclosure; no state or state-fund owner is identified in that filing.
